Subject: Follow-up: Private inference network questions (post demo)

Thanks for the demo earlier — good to see the streaming latency and the model variant fallback in action. A few follow-ups from our infra team that I promised to send: 

1) Target SLOs we need you to validate on private (VPC) deployment:
   - P99 per-token latency seen by app: <= 80ms (goal 50ms)
   - End-to-end first-byte for streaming responses: <= 150ms
   - Sustained throughput target: 250 RPS (inference requests of avg 256 tokens)
   - Concurrency: 60 concurrent sessions with KV cache warm for most users

2) Networking path questions:
   - We plan to connect via AWS Transit Gateway + Direct Connect into our VPC. Can Redwood sit behind our TGW and still maintain sub-80ms p99?
   - Required egress/ingress IPs for firewall allowlist and any expected BGP changes.

3) Validation plan asks:
   - Can you run a pre-prod validation from your side against our staging endpoints using the exact request profile (we'll share a HAR/profile)?

Attaching our rough VPC diagram. Looking for a short list of items you need from us to schedule a lab test next week.

Alex, Jordan — adding the concrete validation steps and the checklist items you should expect from us. Short bullets so your firewall/network team can extract quickly.

Quick checklist (what we'll ask you to provide):
- VPC CIDR and peering/TransGW config snapshot (JSON or diagram)
- BGP ASN and advertised prefixes (if on Direct Connect)
- Staging endpoint FQDN + TLS cert fingerprint (we'll validate SNI behavior)
- ACLs to open: 443 outbound (TLS) to our egress ranges; optional 2200/2222 for management if you want SSH to bastion (we don't need SSH for testing by default)
- Expected NAT MTU (we've seen MTU issues with encapsulated tunnels)

Ports/IPs and egress ranges (preliminary):
- Allow TLS outbound to: 54.211.0.0/16, 3.230.0.0/15 (we'll provide final list)
- BGP sessions: ASN we recommend for test peering: 65010 (if you need a suggestion)

Validation scope we'll run:
- Baseline latency measurement (ICMP/TCP handshake) across Direct Connect + TGW path
- End-to-end streaming test (1k requests with chunked responses) measuring first-byte and per-chunk intervals
- Throughput sweep: 50 -> 300 RPS stepping while tracking cold vs warm KV cache behavior
- Failure mode test: drop 10% of packets at random to observe graceful degradation and model fallback latency increase

Deliverables after run: CSV of per-token latencies, p50/p95/p99 summaries, and a short set of tuning recommendations (batch sizes, concurrency cap, cache TTL). I will attach the formal test plan shortly.
